walkthroughs.body_html:
n = m / Mr.

e.g. 5 g CaCO3 (Mr 100) = 0.05 mol.

c = n / V. Volume in dm^3.

Convert cm^3 to dm^3 by dividing by 1000.

Use pipette for known volume.

Indicator -> add titrant -> end-point.

Take mean of concordant values.

numericals.q: c = n / V. For n = 0.05 mol in 500 cm^3, c in mol/dm^3?
